meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页和终端界面做视觉体检,附截图证据和明确结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面或组件,想确认视觉上没跑偏。
copy.tagline_en: Visually check web and terminal UIs with screenshots and a clear verdict
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page or component and need to confirm it still looks right

howto.what: 在你构建或改动 UI 之后,它会按页面逐一截图取证、跑脚本量出差异与溢出,再派两个只读子代理独立复核,最后给出一页一判的好/坏结论。
howto.when: 在你构建或改动任何 UI 之后、宣布完成之前触发;也用于有人问某个页面、组件或 TUI「看起来对不对」时。没有渲染界面的纯后端逻辑不适用。

say.text: 给刚改的这个页面做视觉 QA,出一份判定
say.note: 会截图比对,并派子代理复核

say.text: 这个终端界面有没有溢出或边框错位?
say.note: 对终端文本跑宽度与边框检查

say.text: 这份 PDF 每一页都渲染出来做视觉检查

howto.what_en: After you build or change a UI, it captures screenshot evidence per page, runs scripts to measure diff and overflow, dispatches two read-only subagents to review, and returns one good/bad verdict per page.
howto.when_en: Use after building or changing any UI, before calling it done, or when someone asks whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Skipped when there is no rendered surface.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on the page I just changed and give a verdict
Does this terminal UI overflow or break its borders?
say_en.note: Runs width and border checks on the capture

say_en.text: Render every page of this PDF for a visual check
